def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    rot180 = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    flip_v = grid[::-1]
    flip_h = [row[::-1] for row in grid]

    def join(left, right):
        return [list(a) + list(b) for a, b in zip(left, right)]

    top = join(rot180, flip_v)
    middle = join(flip_h, grid)
    bottom = join(rot180, flip_v)
    return top + middle + bottom
